name: Декор — острые каменные сколы
subject: ONE fantasy voxel environment dressing asset. Exactly TWO sharp cleaved angular stone pinnacles and ONE low corner chip, coarse stepped triangular forms, heights four and three blocks. Warm gray main stone and broad pale cut faces, one tiny flat olive patch. Preserve three-piece arrangement in all five views. NO earth or ground plate.
caption: Пять ракурсов одного варианта декора. Крупные воксели, чистый фон; без земли и демонстрационной подложки.
prompt_override: Create a BRAND NEW fantasy Minecraft-style voxel asset reference sheet. The supplied image is STYLE ONLY; do not copy its identity or geometry. Exactly FIVE separate complete views of ONE identical asset: front and back on upper row, left profile, right profile and isometric game view on lower row. Large axis-aligned cubes, flat square surfaces and broad coarse pixel material patches. Pure uniform white background, generous margins. NO text, annotations, arrows, panels, labels, ground, dirt, supporting plinth, cast/contact shadows or ambient occlusion. Mild face material color variation only. Subject: Exactly TWO thick broken angular stone shards and ONE separate low corner chip. Shards FOUR and THREE geometric cubes high. Their triangular tips are made entirely of LARGE CUBIC STAIR STEPS, never diagonal slanted smooth mesh planes. Every face axis aligned, Minecraft carved cubical geology. Pale warm gray cut-face pixels and one tiny olive patch, clean white gaps.
